stories.title: EU AI Act Transparency Rules Take Effect
stories.summary: On August 2, 2026, the European Commission's AI Office and national authorities began enforcing mandatory transparency obligations. Interactive AI systems must notify users they are interacting with AI, and synthetic media must carry visible labels and machine-readable metadata.
stories.why_it_matters: Transparency moves from voluntary pledges to legally enforceable front-end design, affecting every app serving European users.
stories.practical_angle: Audit customer-facing forms and media pipelines to ensure automated disclaimers and metadata tagging are active.

stories.title: Anthropic Ships Claude Opus 5 at Half Cost
stories.summary: Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026, at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens. The model provides near-frontier reasoning at half the cost of previous tiers, improving the economics of autonomous agents.
stories.why_it_matters: Lower token costs make multi-step autonomous workflows economically viable for small business deployment.
stories.practical_angle: Review API routing and test swapping high-cost frontier calls to mid-tier models like Opus 5 to cut expenses.

stories.title: The Conference Board Identifies Reskilling Deficit
stories.summary: A study released July 28 revealed that while 55% of workers use AI, only 33% have received employer-provided training, which remains focused on current-role incremental upskilling.
stories.why_it_matters: Businesses risk creating internal skill bottlenecks as workers self-teach unguided AI habits.
stories.practical_angle: Develop training programs that teach employees how to govern AI agents rather than just writing simple prompts.
